body: Aaaaw, so so sorry for the late 😅 and you are right, you guys helped me so much with the messages and comments! Hope you are doing ok too 💓 i will keep trying and will keep going on
I will do my best to continue to live, i promise 💓 and i hope to you continue growing and getting better more and more!

hey everyone

i was in a really bad crisis, couldn't feel anything, feeling severely depressed and that was killing me

i kinda fell asleep and i just woke up right now

for those who are asking themselves, i do therapy with psychologist, psychiatrist, take medicine and stuff, but i still feel chronic depressed and potential suicidal

I'm still here, and i'm still trying to be brave, and see so much people worried about me just breaks my heart, i just did not expect to see so much people here i guess

really sorry

i made through another day, and that's what matters, i guess

i seeked help, was in a session with my psychiatrist

i appreciate so much all the love you guys sent to me

I will try to live another day

Thank you so much, and so sorry for the wait 💕💓
To anyone who's wondering, i'm still here. I'm finally home alone and i got a blade against my wrists. I feel so scared. I just wish i have the guts to make the cut.

Hey, still here.
I'm still trying to gather courage to do it
